**Issue #3568 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3568: Patch: Stinkyscape+ S20, units on existing primitives
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds the set's units that need little that is new: Galaxia, Edwin Van'Spacechief, Cosmic Bard and Shadiris.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP5, SP6, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## Cards

| # | Card |
| --- | --- |
| #74 | Galaxia |
| #102 | Cosmic Bard |
| #162 | Edwin Van’Spacechief (the list's second #83) |
| #165 | Shadiris (the list's second #102) |

## What it builds on

- The foundation (#3535): every card's catalog entry, both faces and a stub script.
- E8 (#3558): casting a card several times.
- S18 (#3557): #68 Shadiris Visions.

## Readings (defaults; change one only with a ruling note)

- #74 Galaxia: the designer's note binds: the first Unit you play after Galaxia, on the turn it is summoned, counts as that turn's first.
- #162 Edwin Van'Spacechief: renumbered from the second #83 (SP5). Combo X: X is the number of cards you played before it this turn (Hearthstone's Edwin).
- #165 Shadiris: renumbered from the second #102 (SP5). "Stinkscape Resources" are the six Stinkyscape Resources. Shadiris Visions is cast twice, each cast with its own Discover.
- #102 Cosmic Bard: its Radiant face sets both drawn Units' costs to the cheaper of the two.

## The designer's text, verbatim

```text
**(2) Galaxia, Unit, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #74**
4/6
**Aura**: The first Unit you play each turn gets +3 Attack. {For AI: Including the first one played after this on the turn this is summoned.}
~~~
8/12
**Aura**: The first Unit you play each turn gets +6 Attack.

**(1) Cosmic Bard, Unit, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #102**
3/2
**Combo**: Draw 2 Units.
~~~
6/4
**Combo**: Draw 2 Units and set both their costs to the cheapest drawn.

**(1) Edwin Van’Spacechief, Unit, Human, Rare, Stinkyscape+, #83**
2/2
**Combo X**: Gain +2X/2X
~~~
4/4
**Combo X**: Gain +4X/4X

**(3) Shadiris, Unit, Epic, Stinkyscape+, #102**
3/13
**Cry:** Cast **Shadiris Visions** twice & add three random **Stinkscape Resources** to your hand.
~~~
6/26
**Cry:** Cast **Radiant Shadiris Visions** twice & add three random **Radiant Stinkscape Resources** to your hand.
```

## Done when

- [ ] Every card above plays its base and Radiant faces by its text and the readings, in its own script file (`crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/cNNN_slug.rs`, the stub the foundation made), with tests for both faces in the same file (CLAUDE.md rules 5 and 6). `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` was read first (rule 10).
- [ ] Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9). A script reads state only through the prelude's helpers. A missing verb or board fact goes into the engine with its test (CLAUDE.md, Architecture).
- [ ] Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note numbered in this issue's block, a test named after it, and its paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3). The cards' §8 rows say what was built.
- [ ] Every prompt these cards open is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for these cards, and `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check` and `names --check` pass.
- [ ] Only these cards' catalog entries and §8 rows are edited (other parts edit theirs side by side), and the set stays `Held`: players see nothing until the release (part R).

Blocked by #3558, #3557

Part of #3534.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43037962973)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Build the four Stinkyscape+ units of S20 (#3568) by their card text plus the issue's readings: #74 Galaxia (first Unit each turn gets +3/+6 Attack, mid-turn arrival armed), #102 Cosmic Bard (Combo: draw 2 Units; Radiant sets both costs to the cheaper), #162 Edwin Van'Spacechief (Combo X self-buff +2X/+4X), #165 Shadiris (Cry: cast Shadiris Visions twice with a Discover each, plus three random (Radiant) Stinkyscape Resources). Each gets its script with base- and Radiant-face tests in its own file, two new ruling notes with proving tests, four §8.12 rows, and catalog `loc` plus the SP5 "Stinkscape" fix. No engine, AI, or web change: every verb exists (E8's `cast_new_times` once #3558 lands).

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c074_galaxia.rs` | change | Trigger script (`TriggerDef`, `remember`/`recalled`, `buff`, `param("attack")`), fixed header comment (it quotes #161's text), tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c102_cosmic_bard.rs` | change | Cry + `condition_met` scripts (`played_earlier`, `draw_from_library`, `set_cost_override`), fixed header (it quotes #165's text), tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs` | change | Cry + `condition_met` scripts (`played_earlier`, `buff`, multiples as consts), tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c165_shadiris.rs` | change | Cry script (`cast_new_times`, `gain_resources`), tests |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change | Four `loc` values from `cargo jackioh catalog loc`; #165 "Stinkscape" → "Stinkyscape" both faces (SP5); nothing else |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | §8.12 rows 74, 102, 162, 165 in numeric position, Engine cell "Built by S20 (#3568)" |
| `spec/rulings/R3568000.md` | new | Galaxia ruling (front matter `id`, `title`, `cards`, `proven_in`) |
| `spec/rulings/R3568001.md` | new | Bard ruling (same front matter) |
| `spec/pending/3568.md` | new | The two §11 paragraphs |

Touch nothing else: not `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `apps/`, `e2e`, other cards' entries or rows, census, fixtures, audio, flavour, FX, or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §6.2 Combo/Aura, §6.3 Cast/Draw/Cost, §10.4 layers, §10.5 steps 4–7, §2.4 draws, Rulings R1, R70, R113, R119, R129, R1420, R1840002, R3558008.

## Steps

1. Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, then `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c068_shadiris_visions.rs` (S18's Discover the Cry reuses), `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c011_double_header.rs` (first-play `CardResolved` trigger, R119 self-exclusion), `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c010_rapid_replenish.rs` (`played_earlier` Combo gate and glow), `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c062_small_time_recruits.rs` (tutor-draw), and E8's `cast_new_times` plus `spec/rulings/R3558008.md` on the `bot/issue-3558` branch (not in this base; step 6 depends on it landing).
2. In `crates/cards/catalog.json`, fix #165's two texts to "Stinkyscape Resources". Leave all other entries alone; update the four `loc`s at step 7.
3. Galaxia (`c074_galaxia.rs`): one `Script` for both faces (Radiant differs only through param `attack`, 3/6, as `training_grounds/c003_group_leader.rs`). One `TriggerDef::new("g74-first-unit", &[GameEventType::CardResolved, GameEventType::Summoned], …)`. On own arrival (event `instance_id` equals self's, either event kind) emit two `remember`s: `ARRIVAL_MARK` = `played_this_turn_of_type(state, controller, &[CardType::Unit])`, `ARRIVAL_TURN` = `state.turn`. On another `CardResolved` with `player == controller` whose `catalog::def_of` type is Unit: skip when `recalled(GRANT_TURN)` is this turn; compute `first` as `count == mark + 1` when the arrival turn is this turn, else `count == 1` (`count` = `played_this_turn_of_type` now); when `first`, emit `buff` of attack `param(ctx, "attack")` on `TargetSpec::Instance` plus `remember(GRANT_TURN, state.turn)`. Copy `TriggerDef`/`remember`/`recalled` call shapes from the step-1 files. Rubric: own arrival only arms, never buffs (R3568000).
4. Bard (`c102_cosmic_bard.rs`): `cry` gates on `played_earlier(state, controller, live_self()) >= COMBO` (`COMBO: i32 = 1`, §6.2), else empty. Pick once in the hook: library Units (`zone_cards`, `card_type_of`, as `c062`), shuffle with `ctx.rng`, take `param(ctx, "summons")` (2/2). Emit one `draw_from_library` per id; Radiant also emits one `set_cost_override` per id with `cost` = the minimum `effective_cost` over the picked ids and `in_hand_only: Some(true)`. `condition_met`: hand zone and gate met (R195, as Rapid Replenish). X-cost Units count 0 toward the minimum (R3568001).
5. Edwin (`c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs`): `fn edwin(multiple: i32) -> Script`; base uses 2, Radiant 4 (`BASE_MULTIPLE`/`RADIANT_MULTIPLE` consts; no catalog params, as `core-038`'s multiples). `cry`: `x = played_earlier(…)`; empty when `x <= 0`, else `buff` self attack and health by `x * multiple`. `condition_met`: hand zone and `x >= 1`.
6. Shadiris (`c165_shadiris.rs`): `fn shadiris(radiant: bool) -> Script`; `cry` returns `cast_new_times(CastNewArgs { def: CastNewDef::Def(CastDef { def_id: "stinkyscapeplus-068", radiant: Some(radiant) }), radiant: None, how: CastHow::default() }, CASTS)` (`CASTS: i32 = 2`, R3558008: two casts, each with its own Discover) followed by `gain_resources(GainResourcesArgs { count: RESOURCES, radiant: radiant.then_some(true), ..default() })` (`RESOURCES: i32 = 3`, R1840002). If E8's landed verb differs in name or shape, use it instead and say so.
7. Run `cargo jackioh catalog loc` for the four script paths and write the four `loc`s into their entries.
8. Add the four §8.12 rows (numeric position): stats/faces from the catalog, Engine cells naming the mechanism and rulings (Galaxia: R3568000 + R119-style self-exclusion; Bard: R3568001; Edwin: X is `played_earlier`, §6.2, multiples are consts; Shadiris: R3558008, R70, R129, R1840002) with "Built by S20 (#3568)". End each Tunes line honestly (Galaxia `attack`, Bard `summons`; Edwin/Shadiris declare no numbers).
9. Write `spec/rulings/R3568000.md` (Galaxia: own arrival never takes the aura per Hearthstone presence; first Unit played while present each turn, once per turn; rejected: buffing itself, per-card-per-turn tracking) and `R3568001.md` (Bard: two random different Units tutored per M #62; cheapest is effective cost as drawn; rejected: top-of-deck, printed cost), each with `proven_in` listing its script file, plus matching paragraphs in `spec/pending/3568.md`.
10. Run the Tests below; fix failures in the scripts, never by touching other files.

## Tests

Card tests live in each script file (`#[cfg(test)] mod tests`), following `c068`'s `scenario`/`play`/`answer` shapes with `mana: 10`:

- `c074_galaxia.rs`: `r3568000_first_unit_each_turn_gets_the_buff` (both faces: +3/+6, second Unit unbuffed); `r3568000_a_unit_before_a_mid_turn_arrival_does_not_consume_it` (play A, play Galaxia, play B: B buffed, A and Galaxia untouched — this also proves own-Summoned reaches the trigger); `r3568000_the_buff_returns_next_turn` (end turns, first Unit buffed again); `r3568000_enemy_units_are_untouched`.
- `c102_cosmic_bard.rs`: `combo_draws_two_units` / `without_combo_draws_nothing` (base); `r3568001_radiant_sets_both_costs_to_the_cheapest` (stand-in (3) + stand-in (1) Units → both cost 1, others unchanged); `one_unit_in_deck_draws_one`.
- `c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs`: `combo_x_gains_twice_x` (2 prior plays → +4/+4); `x_zero_gains_nothing`; `radiant_gains_four_times_x`.
- `c165_shadiris.rs`: `casts_visions_twice_each_with_its_own_discover_and_gains_three_resources` (answer both Discovers; originals stay in deck; three new Resource-tagged cards via `resources_in_hand` as `c052` does); `radiant_casts_radiant_visions_twice_and_gains_radiant_resources`; `a_spell_less_deck_still_gains_resources`.

Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards galaxia`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards cosmic_bard`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards edwin_vanspacechief`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards shadiris`; then `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- All four scripts play both faces with passing tests above; no other catalog entry or §8 row edited.
- R3568000/R3568001 notes exist with `proven_in`, `r3568000_*`/`r3568001_*` tests pass, and `spec/pending/3568.md` holds both paragraphs.
- `loc`s current; `catalog check` and `spec check` pass; fmt and clippy clean.
- No new prompt kinds (Shadiris reuses Visions' Discover, answered in tests); no AI, random-policy, or timeout code — CI's fuzz (which previews the held set) exercises them.
- Every number is the named catalog param or a named script constant; scripts read state only through prelude helpers.

## Risks

- E8 (#3558) had not landed at plan time: `cast_new_times` exists only on `bot/issue-3558`. If it lands differently, Shadiris follows it (one `castNew` per cast stays mandatory per R3558008).
- `remember` in a trigger relies on `self_on_its_stay`; the mid-turn Galaxia test fails loudly if own-Summoned never reaches the trigger, in which case record the mark on own `CardResolved` as well (already planned) and report.
- Tutor-draws and double-casts use seeded rng only; hand-cap burns and cast-on-draw draws are covered by existing semantics (`in_hand_only`, R58) and asserted in the partial/empty-deck tests.

## Open questions

None blocking. Medium stands: one crate's four script files plus notes and rows, no engine, AI, cross-crate, migration, or large-scale work.
````

## Goal

Build the four Stinkyscape+ units of S20 (#3568) by their card text plus the issue's readings: #74 Galaxia (first Unit each turn gets +3/+6 Attack, mid-turn arrival armed), #102 Cosmic Bard (Combo: draw 2 Units; Radiant sets both costs to the cheaper), #162 Edwin Van'Spacechief (Combo X self-buff +2X/+4X), #165 Shadiris (Cry: cast Shadiris Visions twice with a Discover each, plus three random (Radiant) Stinkyscape Resources). Each gets its script with base- and Radiant-face tests in its own file, two new ruling notes with proving tests, four §8.12 rows, and catalog `loc` plus the SP5 "Stinkscape" fix. No engine, AI, or web change: every verb exists (E8's `cast_new_times` once #3558 lands).

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c074_galaxia.rs` | change | Trigger script (`TriggerDef`, `remember`/`recalled`, `buff`, `param("attack")`), fixed header comment (it quotes #161's text), tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c102_cosmic_bard.rs` | change | Cry + `condition_met` scripts (`played_earlier`, `draw_from_library`, `set_cost_override`), fixed header (it quotes #165's text), tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs` | change | Cry + `condition_met` scripts (`played_earlier`, `buff`, multiples as consts), tests |
| `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c165_shadiris.rs` | change | Cry script (`cast_new_times`, `gain_resources`), tests |
| `crates/cards/catalog.json` | change | Four `loc` values from `cargo jackioh catalog loc`; #165 "Stinkscape" → "Stinkyscape" both faces (SP5); nothing else |
| `spec/08-catalog.md` | change | §8.12 rows 74, 102, 162, 165 in numeric position, Engine cell "Built by S20 (#3568)" |
| `spec/rulings/R3568000.md` | new | Galaxia ruling (front matter `id`, `title`, `cards`, `proven_in`) |
| `spec/rulings/R3568001.md` | new | Bard ruling (same front matter) |
| `spec/pending/3568.md` | new | The two §11 paragraphs |

Touch nothing else: not `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `apps/`, `e2e`, other cards' entries or rows, census, fixtures, audio, flavour, FX, or `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §6.2 Combo/Aura, §6.3 Cast/Draw/Cost, §10.4 layers, §10.5 steps 4–7, §2.4 draws, Rulings R1, R70, R113, R119, R129, R1420, R1840002, R3558008.

## Steps

1. Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md`, then `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c068_shadiris_visions.rs` (S18's Discover the Cry reuses), `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c011_double_header.rs` (first-play `CardResolved` trigger, R119 self-exclusion), `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c010_rapid_replenish.rs` (`played_earlier` Combo gate and glow), `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c062_small_time_recruits.rs` (tutor-draw), and E8's `cast_new_times` plus `spec/rulings/R3558008.md` on the `bot/issue-3558` branch (not in this base; step 6 depends on it landing).
2. In `crates/cards/catalog.json`, fix #165's two texts to "Stinkyscape Resources". Leave all other entries alone; update the four `loc`s at step 7.
3. Galaxia (`c074_galaxia.rs`): one `Script` for both faces (Radiant differs only through param `attack`, 3/6, as `training_grounds/c003_group_leader.rs`). One `TriggerDef::new("g74-first-unit", &[GameEventType::CardResolved, GameEventType::Summoned], …)`. On own arrival (event `instance_id` equals self's, either event kind) emit two `remember`s: `ARRIVAL_MARK` = `played_this_turn_of_type(state, controller, &[CardType::Unit])`, `ARRIVAL_TURN` = `state.turn`. On another `CardResolved` with `player == controller` whose `catalog::def_of` type is Unit: skip when `recalled(GRANT_TURN)` is this turn; compute `first` as `count == mark + 1` when the arrival turn is this turn, else `count == 1` (`count` = `played_this_turn_of_type` now); when `first`, emit `buff` of attack `param(ctx, "attack")` on `TargetSpec::Instance` plus `remember(GRANT_TURN, state.turn)`. Copy `TriggerDef`/`remember`/`recalled` call shapes from the step-1 files. Rubric: own arrival only arms, never buffs (R3568000).
4. Bard (`c102_cosmic_bard.rs`): `cry` gates on `played_earlier(state, controller, live_self()) >= COMBO` (`COMBO: i32 = 1`, §6.2), else empty. Pick once in the hook: library Units (`zone_cards`, `card_type_of`, as `c062`), shuffle with `ctx.rng`, take `param(ctx, "summons")` (2/2). Emit one `draw_from_library` per id; Radiant also emits one `set_cost_override` per id with `cost` = the minimum `effective_cost` over the picked ids and `in_hand_only: Some(true)`. `condition_met`: hand zone and gate met (R195, as Rapid Replenish). X-cost Units count 0 toward the minimum (R3568001).
5. Edwin (`c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs`): `fn edwin(multiple: i32) -> Script`; base uses 2, Radiant 4 (`BASE_MULTIPLE`/`RADIANT_MULTIPLE` consts; no catalog params, as `core-038`'s multiples). `cry`: `x = played_earlier(…)`; empty when `x <= 0`, else `buff` self attack and health by `x * multiple`. `condition_met`: hand zone and `x >= 1`.
6. Shadiris (`c165_shadiris.rs`): `fn shadiris(radiant: bool) -> Script`; `cry` returns `cast_new_times(CastNewArgs { def: CastNewDef::Def(CastDef { def_id: "stinkyscapeplus-068", radiant: Some(radiant) }), radiant: None, how: CastHow::default() }, CASTS)` (`CASTS: i32 = 2`, R3558008: two casts, each with its own Discover) followed by `gain_resources(GainResourcesArgs { count: RESOURCES, radiant: radiant.then_some(true), ..default() })` (`RESOURCES: i32 = 3`, R1840002). If E8's landed verb differs in name or shape, use it instead and say so.
7. Run `cargo jackioh catalog loc` for the four script paths and write the four `loc`s into their entries.
8. Add the four §8.12 rows (numeric position): stats/faces from the catalog, Engine cells naming the mechanism and rulings (Galaxia: R3568000 + R119-style self-exclusion; Bard: R3568001; Edwin: X is `played_earlier`, §6.2, multiples are consts; Shadiris: R3558008, R70, R129, R1840002) with "Built by S20 (#3568)". End each Tunes line honestly (Galaxia `attack`, Bard `summons`; Edwin/Shadiris declare no numbers).
9. Write `spec/rulings/R3568000.md` (Galaxia: own arrival never takes the aura per Hearthstone presence; first Unit played while present each turn, once per turn; rejected: buffing itself, per-card-per-turn tracking) and `R3568001.md` (Bard: two random different Units tutored per M #62; cheapest is effective cost as drawn; rejected: top-of-deck, printed cost), each with `proven_in` listing its script file, plus matching paragraphs in `spec/pending/3568.md`.
10. Run the Tests below; fix failures in the scripts, never by touching other files.

## Tests

Card tests live in each script file (`#[cfg(test)] mod tests`), following `c068`'s `scenario`/`play`/`answer` shapes with `mana: 10`:

- `c074_galaxia.rs`: `r3568000_first_unit_each_turn_gets_the_buff` (both faces: +3/+6, second Unit unbuffed); `r3568000_a_unit_before_a_mid_turn_arrival_does_not_consume_it` (play A, play Galaxia, play B: B buffed, A and Galaxia untouched — this also proves own-Summoned reaches the trigger); `r3568000_the_buff_returns_next_turn` (end turns, first Unit buffed again); `r3568000_enemy_units_are_untouched`.
- `c102_cosmic_bard.rs`: `combo_draws_two_units` / `without_combo_draws_nothing` (base); `r3568001_radiant_sets_both_costs_to_the_cheapest` (stand-in (3) + stand-in (1) Units → both cost 1, others unchanged); `one_unit_in_deck_draws_one`.
- `c162_edwin_vanspacechief.rs`: `combo_x_gains_twice_x` (2 prior plays → +4/+4); `x_zero_gains_nothing`; `radiant_gains_four_times_x`.
- `c165_shadiris.rs`: `casts_visions_twice_each_with_its_own_discover_and_gains_three_resources` (answer both Discovers; originals stay in deck; three new Resource-tagged cards via `resources_in_hand` as `c052` does); `radiant_casts_radiant_visions_twice_and_gains_radiant_resources`; `a_spell_less_deck_still_gains_resources`.

Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards galaxia`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards cosmic_bard`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards edwin_vanspacechief`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards shadiris`; then `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- All four scripts play both faces with passing tests above; no other catalog entry or §8 row edited.
- R3568000/R3568001 notes exist with `proven_in`, `r3568000_*`/`r3568001_*` tests pass, and `spec/pending/3568.md` holds both paragraphs.
- `loc`s current; `catalog check` and `spec check` pass; fmt and clippy clean.
- No new prompt kinds (Shadiris reuses Visions' Discover, answered in tests); no AI, random-policy, or timeout code — CI's fuzz (which previews the held set) exercises them.
- Every number is the named catalog param or a named script constant; scripts read state only through prelude helpers.

## Risks

- E8 (#3558) had not landed at plan time: `cast_new_times` exists only on `bot/issue-3558`. If it lands differently, Shadiris follows it (one `castNew` per cast stays mandatory per R3558008).
- `remember` in a trigger relies on `self_on_its_stay`; the mid-turn Galaxia test fails loudly if own-Summoned never reaches the trigger, in which case record the mark on own `CardResolved` as well (already planned) and report.
- Tutor-draws and double-casts use seeded rng only; hand-cap burns and cast-on-draw draws are covered by existing semantics (`in_hand_only`, R58) and asserted in the partial/empty-deck tests.

## Open questions

None blocking. Medium stands: one crate's four script files plus notes and rows, no engine, AI, cross-crate, migration, or large-scale work.
